description: This file defines interfaces for the HTTP/1.x protocol layer within the lighttpd server, including functions for sending responses, receiving headers, reading request bodies, and handling timeouts.

methods.name: h1_send_1xx
methods.description: Sends an informational 1xx response to the client.

methods.name: h1_send_headers
methods.description: Sends HTTP headers for a request.

methods.name: h1_recv_headers
methods.description: Receives HTTP headers from the client.

methods.name: h1_check_timeout
methods.description: Checks for timeout conditions on a connection.
